en: Your jaw acts as a third-class lever because the jaw joint is the fulcrum and your teeth are the load.
Ice feels slippery because the friction from your sliding shoes melts a microscopic layer of water on the solid surface.
If you weigh sixty kilograms on Earth, you would weigh only ten kilograms on the Moon due to its weaker gravity.
Earth's geographic North Pole is actually a magnetic south pole, which is why the north end of a compass points there.
A single bolt of lightning heats the surrounding air to thirty thousand degrees Celsius, five times hotter than the Sun's surface.
Diamonds sparkle brilliantly because total internal reflection traps light inside the gem, bouncing it around before it finally exits.
Sound travels roughly four times faster in water than in air because liquid water molecules are packed much closer together.
Metal feels colder than wood at room temperature because it rapidly conducts heat away from your warm skin.
A roller coaster's gravitational potential energy at the top of a steep hill transforms into kinetic energy as it drops.
Sound cannot travel through the vacuum of outer space because there are no air molecules to vibrate and carry the acoustic waves.
A straw looks broken in a glass of water because light waves bend, or refract, when they pass from water into air.
Hot air rises because heating it makes the air molecules spread apart, decreasing the air's density compared to the cooler surrounding air.
